A rotary cutter unit (6) for an agricultural mower (2) comprises a housing (14) that carries a rotary bearing (18) having an axis of rotation (X), and a rotor assembly (20) that is supported by the bearing for rotation relative to the housing about the axis of rotation. The rotor assembly includes a shaft (24) that extends through the bearing, a drive input element (28) at an input end of the shaft for transmitting rotary drive to the shaft and a drive output element (32) at an output end (22) of the shaft to receive rotary drive from the shaft. A frangible element (40) comprising a weakened portion of the shaft (24) is provided between the drive input element and the drive output element, which is configured to break when subjected to an excessive load so as to interrupt the transmission of rotary drive between the drive input element and the drive output element. A retention mechanism (44) is provided, which prevents separation of the drive output element from the housing when the frangible element breaks but permits rotation of the drive output element relative to the housing. The retention mechanism includes a retention element (46, 48) that extends substantially radially between the drive output element (32) and the housing (14) to restrict axial movement between the drive output element and the housing.

A rotary cutting unit (6) for an agricultural mower (2) has a casing (14) supporting a rotary bearing (18) arranged around a rotational axis (X). A rotor assembly (20) is mounted in the bearing so that it can turn about axis (X) relative to the casing. The assembly comprises a shaft (24) passing through the bearing, a drive-input member (28) located at the shaft’s input end and configured to deliver rotational power to the shaft, and a drive-output member (32) positioned at the shaft’s output end (22) to receive rotational power from it.

Between the input and output members, the shaft includes a deliberately weakened section forming a breakable element (40). When an excessive load is applied, this section fractures and thereby stops rotational drive from being transferred between the drive-input and drive-output members. A retaining arrangement (44) keeps the drive-output member attached to the casing after the breakable element fails while still allowing the output member to rotate relative to the casing. This arrangement includes a retaining member (46, 48) extending generally in a radial direction between the drive-output member (32) and the casing (14), thereby limiting their relative axial displacement.
outputs.L3:
A rotary cutter unit for an agricultural mower comprises a housing, a rotary bearing supported by the housing, and a rotor assembly configured to rotate about the axis of the bearing. The rotor assembly includes a shaft provided with a drive input element and a drive output element. The drive input element transmits rotary drive to the shaft, while the drive output element receives rotary drive from the shaft for operating the cutter unit.

A frangible element is located along the shaft between the drive input element and the drive output element. This element is formed by a weakened portion of the shaft designed to break when the rotor assembly is subjected to an excessive load. Breakage of the frangible element interrupts the transmission of rotary drive between the drive input and drive output elements, thereby protecting other components of the mower from damage.

The cutter unit further includes a radial retention mechanism that retains the drive output element relative to the housing following breakage of the frangible element. In particular, the mechanism prevents the drive output element from separating axially from the housing while permitting the drive output element to continue rotating relative to the housing.
outputs.L4:
A rotary cutter unit for an agricultural mower includes a housing, a drive input element, and a drive output element connected to a rotary cutting member. During normal operation, torque is transmitted from the drive input element to the drive output element through a shaft supported within the housing. The shaft includes a deliberately weakened portion that is designed to fracture when the cutter unit is subjected to a load exceeding a predetermined limit, such as when the cutting member strikes a stone or another rigid obstruction.

Fracture of the weakened shaft portion interrupts the transmission of power from the drive input element to the drive output element. This controlled failure protects other parts of the mower drivetrain from potentially more extensive damage. After the shaft has fractured, however, the drive output element and the associated cutting components may retain substantial rotational energy.

To prevent these components from becoming detached, the cutter unit further includes a radial retention mechanism acting between the drive output element and the housing. The retention mechanism restrains radial displacement and keeps the drive output element secured to the housing after failure of the shaft. At the same time, it permits the output element to continue rotating relative to the housing so that its residual kinetic energy can dissipate gradually rather than being stopped abruptly.

The combination of the weakened shaft portion and the radial retention mechanism therefore provides both overload protection and post-failure containment. It limits damage to the drive system, reduces the risk of loose or ejected components, and improves the safety and reliability of the agricultural mower.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for a rotary cutter unit for an agricultural mower, including a housing, bearing-supported rotor shaft, drive input and output elements, a frangible shaft portion, and a retention mechanism that prevents separation after breakage while allowing rotation.
counterfactuals.output: A rotary cutter unit for an agricultural mower includes a housing and a rotor shaft rotatably supported within the housing by at least one bearing. A drive input element is coupled to a first portion of the rotor shaft, and a drive output element is coupled to a second portion of the rotor shaft for transmitting torque to a cutting member. The rotor shaft includes a frangible portion configured to break upon application of a torque exceeding a predetermined threshold, thereby interrupting torque transmission between the drive input and drive output elements. A retention mechanism extends between or engages the first and second shaft portions to prevent axial separation of the portions following breakage of the frangible portion. The retention mechanism permits relative rotation of the broken shaft portions, thereby containing the separated components within the housing while reducing transmission of damaging loads to other components of the mower.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an agricultural mower cutter assembly in formal technical language, preserving component reference numerals and explaining how the weakened shaft section interrupts drive under excessive load.
counterfactuals.output:
An agricultural mower cutter assembly **(10)** comprises a cutter bar **(12)** supporting a plurality of rotary cutting units **(14)**. Each cutting unit **(14)** includes a rotatable cutter disc **(16)** carrying one or more cutting blades **(18)** and mounted on a substantially vertical drive shaft **(20)**. The drive shaft **(20)** is operatively coupled to a transmission **(22)** disposed within or adjacent to the cutter bar **(12)**, whereby rotational power is transmitted from an input drive **(24)** to the cutter disc **(16)**.

The drive shaft **(20)** includes a deliberately weakened shaft section **(26)** positioned between a driven portion **(28)** connected to the transmission **(22)** and an output portion **(30)** connected to the cutter disc **(16)**. The weakened shaft section **(26)** may be defined by a reduced-diameter neck, circumferential groove, bore, or other localized reduction in torsional strength.

During normal operation, the weakened shaft section **(26)** transmits the required driving torque from the transmission **(22)** to the cutter disc **(16)**. If the cutter disc **(16)** strikes an obstruction or becomes jammed, the resulting torque rises above a predetermined threshold. The weakened shaft section **(26)** then fails preferentially in torsion, separating the driven portion **(28)** from the output portion **(30)**. This separation interrupts torque transmission to the affected cutter disc **(16)** while limiting the transfer of excessive load to the transmission **(22)** and other components of the cutter assembly **(10)**. The weakened shaft section **(26)** thus functions as a sacrificial mechanical overload device and may be replaced to restore the drive connection.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2
